verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents wallet/balance/payout mechanics, dispute/chargeback contest workflows, webhooks for status tracking, and exposes an OpenAPI spec plus an official MCP server and llms.txt/markdown-friendly docs explicitly for AI agents — directly enabling agent-usable balance/payout inspection and dispute-evidence drafting. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of an agent actually executing this balance-investigation/dispute-drafting workflow end-to-end via the MCP server.
